# Andi Muchlas Ramadani - Software Engineer Portfolio

A retro terminal-themed portfolio showcasing expertise in backend development, spatial systems, distributed workflows, and real-time simulations.

## Technical Skills
- Backend: Go (Golang), TypeScript, Bun, Hono.js, gRPC, Redis, BullMQ, NATS, PostgreSQL
- Spatial: OSRM, PostGIS, Uber H3, Routing Engines
- ML & Routing: PyTorch, DistilBERT, Model Orchestration
- Visualization & Simulation: Unity (C#), LiDAR integration, Real-time Simulation systems
- DevOps & Cloud: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS S3, Linux
- UI/UX: Terminal User Interfaces (TUI), Retro CRT aesthetics

## Experience Summary
Software engineer with 2+ years of experience in high-throughput backend microservices, spatial computing, and Unity simulations. Focuses on performance, spatial computation, and event-driven architectures.
